jobs.occupation: Senior Regulatory Data Professional - Structured Content (Docuvera) - Fixed-term contract
jobs.description:
**Your impact begins here

**Help shape how structured regulatory content is created, managed and used across a global organisation. As our Senior Regulatory Data Professional (****Fixed-term contract for 12 months), you will strengthen data quality, improve the way colleagues work in Docuvera and support the development of faster, more efficient global submissions. Your expertise will help create a reliable digital foundation for regulatory writing and label development.

**What You’ll Bring

**You combine knowledge of structured content with strong analytical skills and a practical understanding of how digital tools support regulatory work. You communicate complex topics clearly and can bring stakeholders together around effective, sustainable solutions.

**We Are Looking For Someone With

**

• Hands-on experience with structured content authoring and associated tools in a pharmaceutical environment. Experience with Docuvera would be particularly relevant.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to investigate data-quality issues and turn findings into workable solutions.

• The ability to communicate technical or process-related topics clearly and succinctly to different audiences.

• A good understanding of business needs, combined with strong digital capabilities.

• A collaborative, proactive and structured approach to working with stakeholders across functions and geographies.

• Experience with label text and label management, which would be an advantage rather than an essential requirement.

**What You’ll Do

**In this role, you will become a subject-matter expert for structured content processes and help colleagues use Docuvera effectively. You will:

• Develop, maintain and continuously improve structured content functionality and processes in Docuvera.

• Translate business needs into clear requirements and support testing, documentation and implementation activities.

• Analyse and resolve regulatory data challenges while helping maintain alignment with relevant external standards.

• Use data insights to identify improvement opportunities and support better business and regulatory outcomes.

• Lead or contribute to process-optimisation initiatives across Regulatory Scientific Writing and related functional areas.

• Support adoption through stakeholder engagement, user-focused communication, training, change support and the sharing of best practices.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join the newly established Label Writing and Management team within Regulatory Scientific Writing. The team develops and supports the regulatory data, systems and processes used in label development across Novo Nordisk.

Your work will connect you with colleagues across Regulatory Affairs, Research and Development, and affiliates worldwide. You can expect a highly cross-functional environment where regulatory knowledge, digital expertise and user needs come together. You will have the opportunity to influence how new ways of working are designed and adopted across global teams.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will have the opportunity to shape an evolving area of regulatory work and contribute to solutions that can improve both quality and efficiency. You will work in a global environment where curiosity, clear thinking and constructive collaboration are valued.

At Novo Nordisk, opportunities to learn and develop are part of the experience, while employee benefits are designed with different career and life stages in mind.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 651,000.00 to 956,900.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks. Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to strengthen structured regulatory content and help build smarter global submission processes, apply for the Senior Regulatory Data Professional – Structured Content (Docuvera) role by 15 November 2026.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Senior Manager in Partnerships

The Danish and Icelandic Affiliate | Novo

Are you passionate about building partnerships that can shape the future of healthcare? Do you have an entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to turn emerging opportunities into sustainable solutions for patients and the business?

We are looking for a Senior Manager in Partnerships to join the Danish and Icelandic Affiliate to help identify, develop and drive business growth through strategic partnerships.

In this exciting position you will build strong collaboration with eHealth providers and healthcare partners supporting our ambitions for patients and our business.

What you’ll bring

• An advanced degree (MBA or equivalent) in Business Administration, Project Management or a related field.

• At least 5 years of experience in strategic partnerships, external stakeholder management, commercial strategy or consulting.

• Experience managing teams and developing talent, including setting objectives, coaching and managing performance.

• Solid business development and key account management experience and a proven track record of developing, negotiating and managing strategic partnerships and alliances.

• A strong understanding of the healthcare ecosystem and the trends and challenges shaping the industry.

• Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to translate complex information into actionable insights.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English, written and spoken.

What you’ll do

As Senior Manager, Partnerships, you will identify, develop, and maintain strategic partnerships opportunities aligned with Novo's strategic priorities.

A key part of your role will be exploring what comes next. You will identify changes in the healthcare environment, assess emerging opportunities and help translate them into new partnerships, patient solutions and commercial approaches.

**Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Identify and develop strategic partnerships and new business opportunities, from market insight and initial dialogue through implementation and ongoing relationship management.

• Analyse market developments and identifying opportunities for growth across our existing and future portfolio.

• Build new collaborations, ecosystems and commercial solutions that respond to changes in the healthcare environment and support sustainable business growth.

• Lead the Key Account Managers in driving performance with e-Health providers and pharmacies within obesity and diabetes through territory planning, customer segmentation and coordinated, compliant customer engagement.

• Develop patient solutions that improve patient access, education and adherence in collaboration with the marketing team.

• Drive cross-functional execution and translate partnership performance into recommendations, working closely with Commercial, Communication, Sales, MAPA and Medical and providing relevant insights to Leadership Teams.

Who you’ll work with

You will join the Partnerships team in the Danish and Icelandic Affiliate and report to the Director, Sales & Partnerships. You will lead a team of five, including Strategic Partnerships Managers, an Associate Alliance Manager and Key Account Managers, covering Denmark. Externally, your stakeholder landscape will depend on the opportunities you pursue and include, eHealth providers, private hospitals, private specialists insurance companies and other relevant healthcare and industry partners.

We are looking for a person who is comfortable navigating complex stakeholder environments, creating connections and bringing different perspectives together around shared opportunities. Where others see obstacles, you see opportunities.

What you can expect here

At Novo, we work to drive change to defeat serious chronic diseases. Achieving that ambition increasingly requires us to look beyond traditional ways of working and collaborate across the healthcare ecosystem.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to explore new possibilities, build strategic partnerships and help develop innovative approaches that connect patient needs, healthcare transformation and sustainable business opportunities.

If you are motivated by creating something new, bringing partners together and turning opportunities into solutions that can make a difference for patients, we would like to hear from you.

**What We Offer

**At Novo Nordisk, you’ll join a global healthcare company with a unique culture and strong results. We offer continuous learning, career development, and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 742,560.00 to 1,091,600.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

Apply now and join us in shaping new partnerships and opportunities for the future of healthcare

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to build partnerships that turn patient and customer needs into measurable progress in Denmark, apply for the Sr. Manager, Partnerships role by 18 November 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

As a person, you are strategic, customer-focused and decisive, with a strong ability to create clarity in complex environments. You are a natural collaborator who can build relationships across functions while confidently challenging existing ways of working when needed. You combine commercial awareness with an analytical and pragmatic approach and are motivated by creating measurable improvements in both customer experience and business performance.

Experience or certification in ITIL, product management, service design or customer experience is considered an advantage.

Do you want to know more?

In this process atNorth is working with Level Recruitment. To apply, please click the apply button. If you have further questions don´t hesitate to contact senior recruitment consultant Christian Smith at +46 8 120 50 400.

Location: Central Copenhagen; primarily in office

Language: English

**Highlights

**

• Full-Stack Python/TS engineer needed for a B2B SaaS startup in Copenhagen (with plenty of traction!)

• We have a lean, get-stuff-done team. No annoying extra management layers or unnecessary bureaucratic rituals. And we are "AI-forward" in our own development practices.

• You will own features end to end, from the data model through to the screen, on a platform that manufacturers rely on to keep production lines running.

• You will work in a small engineering team, directly with the person who decides what we build, and the problems you spend your time on are hard because the domain is hard, not because the organization is.

• We're building legitimately useful tools for the industries and companies that make the world go around.... manufacturers. Both AI-tools and just "plain-old-good-software" tools.

**About Supplios

**Manufacturers live or die by their supply base. Sourcing the wrong supplier, onboarding one slowly, failing to qualify one properly or losing track of a non-conformance can stop a production line and cost millions. Yet most manufacturers still run these relationships across email chains, spreadsheets and shared drives.

Supplios is a supplier collaboration platform for manufacturers in automotive and industrial sectors. We cover the full supplier relationship: sourcing, onboarding, qualification, day-to-day collaboration, compliance and supplier quality, all in a modern cloud based platform that is easy for manufacturers to implement and operate. It is built specifically for the way automotive and industrial manufacturers actually work.

We are headquartered in central Copenhagen and already serve customers globally in our vertical, including some of the most demanding names in automotive. We have grown to this point almost entirely on product strength, domain credibility and word of mouth.

The platform now covers more ground than the team that built it. We are hiring engineers to keep that pace sustainable, and to go deeper on the parts of the product our customers are pushing hardest.

The role

You will join a small engineering team and work across the whole stack: Python on the backend, TypeScript on the frontend and in the AI layers. There is no split between people who design and people who implement. You will take a problem from a customer conversation or a product decision through to something running in production for real manufacturers.

You will work directly with our co-founder and CEO, who is a hands-on product builder himself. That means short conversations instead of tickets thrown over a wall, and it means your questions about why something should work a certain way get answered by the person who decided it.

The domain is genuinely complicated, and that is the interesting part. Supplier relationships in automotive involve deep hierarchies, long-running approval processes, strict audit requirements and a lot of state that has to be exactly right. Modeling that well is most of the job.

Title and level flex with experience. We are open to strong mid-level engineers and to senior engineers who want more scope than their current company gives them.

We work together from our office in central Copenhagen. This is primarily an in-office role: at this stage, and on a codebase with this much implicit context, working through problems with the rest of the team in person is much faster than doing it in writing. Sensible flexibility when you need it is a given; full-time remote is not what we are offering.

**Our Current Stack

**

• Backend: Python / Django

• Frontend: Vue (but no specific Vue experience is needed)

• Infrastructure: AWS (mostly)

• Agents: Cloudflare (TypeScript) + Claude & OpenAI platform

What you will do

• Build features end to end, from data model and backend logic through to the TypeScript frontend our customers actually click on.

• Build end-to-end / front-to-back AI features (in-app AI assistants, background worker agents, email-routing agents, customer-configurable agent framework components)

• Design and evolve the relational data model that sits under supplier relationships, approvals and quality records.

• Take vaguely defined customer problems and turn them into something specific enough to build, then build it.

• Work on integrations between Supplios and customer systems (ERP and adjacent tooling), where failures have visible consequences for a production line.

• Improve the parts of the codebase that need it, rather than routing around them.

• Review other people's code and have yours reviewed; we keep the loop tight and unbureaucratic.

• Help keep the platform healthy in production across our regions: errors, performance and the boring things that keep customers trusting us.

• Take part in product decisions. Engineers here are expected to have opinions about what we build, not just how.

What we are looking for

**Essential

**

• Professional experience with Python. This is not negotiable; the backend is Python and you need to be effective in it.

• Solid TypeScript experience and genuine comfort working on the frontend.

• Experience building and running SaaS products, including the part after launch where real users depend on them.

• AI-forward development techniques. (This does not mean you no longer write code.)

• A track record of owning work end to end without waiting to be told what to do next.

• The temperament for a small, senior company: high ownership, low ceremony.

• You want to work primarily from an office in central Copenhagen, with a small team.

**Nice to have

**Genuinely a plus, not a requirement. Nobody has all of these.

• Experience with B2B enterprise SaaS, especially where customers are large and demanding and implementations are not self-serve. This is a significant plus.

• Experience with complex relational data modeling, and with large, long-lived codebases that you did not write yourself. A big plus.

• Experience building AI-based products, using the latest frameworks/harnesses and infrastructure components (including RAG) is a significant plus.

• Familiarity with any of: domain-driven design, the actor model, finite state machines, CQRS, event-driven architecture. We use these ideas where they earn their place, and it helps if the vocabulary is already yours.

• Startup experience, particularly early stage. A significant plus.

• Knowledge of manufacturing, automotive or supply chain. Useful, but we can teach you the domain; we cannot teach you the craft, so do not rule yourself out on this.

**Language

**English is the only important language for this position; we work in English, and so do our customers. Danish language skills are not required.

Why this role is worth your time

• The scope is unusually large for the stage. You are one of a small number of engineers on a platform that serves demanding customers globally. What you build ships, and it ships soon.

• No layers between you and the decisions. You work directly with the co-founder and CEO, who runs product. There is no committee to navigate and nobody to translate your work for you.

• Hard problems that are not artificially hard. The complexity comes from the domain (hierarchies, state, audit trails, integrations that must not fail), not from organisational overhead.

• Real customers already, and real gaps. The product has paying customers in automotive and clear places where it needs to get better. Both halves of that are true, and both are why this is a good job.

How to apply

Send your CV and a short note on why this role interests you to team@supplios.com. Work examples will help.

jobs.occupation: Senior Technician – Mammalian Downstream Manufacturing (Night Shift)
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced downstream technician with hands-on knowledge of chromatography, filtration, and UF/DF processes? Do you enjoy working independently while sharing your expertise with colleagues?

**At AGC Biologics, we are looking for a Senior Technician to join our Mammalian Downstream Manufacturing team in Copenhagen.

You will work in a dynamic, GMP-regulated manufacturing environment where different products and customer requirements call for technical expertise, adaptability, and attention to detail. As part of the team, you will contribute to reliable production while helping strengthen the technical capabilities of your colleagues.

**About The Job

**As a Senior Technician, you will be responsible for executing downstream purification processes and ensuring that manufacturing activities are carried out safely, efficiently, and in compliance with GMP requirements.

You will work independently within your area of expertise while collaborating with colleagues to meet production goals. The role requires strong process understanding, sound judgement, and the ability to adapt to different manufacturing setups without compromising quality.

**Your Main Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Executing downstream purification processes, including chromatography, filtration, and ultrafiltration/diafiltration (UF/DF).

• Operating chromatography systems, including UNICORN software, and applying your technical understanding during production.

• Ensuring accurate GMP documentation and compliance with approved procedures and aseptic practices.

• Supporting troubleshooting, deviation investigations, and continuous improvement activities.

• Taking ownership of your training, technical qualifications, and development.

• Sharing knowledge and providing hands-on training and guidance to less experienced colleagues.

As you become familiar with our processes, we expect you to take an active role in supporting the development of new colleagues and contributing to high standards of technical performance and GMP behaviour within the team.

**Who Are We Looking For?

**We are looking for an experienced technician with a solid understanding of downstream purification and a strong commitment to quality and compliance.

**We Imagine That You

**

• Have approximately 3–5 years of experience in GMP-regulated manufacturing, preferably within biopharmaceutical production.

• Have an educational background as a Process Operator, Industrial Technician, Biotechnology Technician, or an equivalent relevant technical qualification.

• Have hands-on experience with chromatography, filtration, and UF/DF processes.

• Have a good understanding of UNICORN chromatography systems.

• Are familiar with GMP requirements, aseptic practices, and accurate production documentation.

• Can independently execute complex manufacturing activities and contribute to solving technical challenges.

Beyond your technical experience, we value colleagues who take ownership of their work and development, maintain high standards of quality, and contribute positively to the team.

You work in a structured way, adapt to changing production needs, and willingly share your knowledge. You communicate openly and understand when to ask for support or escalate an issue rather than compromise quality or compliance.

• Ensure scheduled tasks, ADs, EOs, inspections, modifications and other approved requirements are included.

• Coordinate material, component, rotable and modification-kit availability with Logistics.

• Align technical scope, schedule and readiness with Engineering, MCC, Technical Records and the selected MRO.
